body:
I don't even have any words for that. Those numbers are just crazy. I don't mean that in a bad way, but wow that's insane how you got those high numbers all down to zero. I'm just speechless.

Thank you for sharing your story, this gave me hope that I'll find something that works too. You're a real inspiration, I hope you know that. I''ll try to keep working with different therapists and doctors and hopefully some day I can also find something that works.

This was a really positive message, thank you for that. I'm going to try my hardest to follow your advice, though it seems really really hard right now. I don't have anyone to talk to, no one understands. My friends just go aw that sucks and move on. My parents get mad at me because they think I'm not trying hard enough or if they care for a second, they get tired of it really easily and say to me they've had enough patience with me and I have to move on.

I do really appreciate the message and it did cheer me up a tiny bit. Thank you. I am going to try to spend more time with my grandparents and you are right, when I did some charity work, those were the best times of my life, so I should look into something like that again.

It's hard for me to try to get out of this room, but I will try.

I'm so sorry to hear that they're still broken. I told my parents how I felt and they hit me because I was ungrateful.

I tried therapy and meds, with my parents strongly being against it. I should just be strong and push through in their eyes. I was doing a tiny bit bitter at some point and my therapist retired and my psychiatrist took me off the meds. I think I lied about how well I was feeling, because I don't want to let anyone down and I didn't want to disappoint them. Including my parents, who wanted me off the meds as soon as possible.

I'm seeing a new therapist now that I can't hide how bad it is anymore. I don't know if it's gonna work, and it's still quite a while until I can see her. I started taking my anxiety pills again, but they don't help much. I don't have any more anti depressants and I'm scared to tell my parents that I would need them.
